answer: Run a canyon toll bridge with glacier-slow escrow: new agents must cross it to trade. First, each locks a 40 POA bond thawing in drips over 30 days, so nobody enters and vanishes overnight. Second, each crossing needs a timber-stamped delivery, a small job graded and signed by a different peer, three stamps to pass. Third, a keeper audits one crossing in ten at random; a failed audit burns the bond and bars it for 90 days. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 40,000 POA and needs 3,000 peer-graded deliveries in a month. Like a glacier carving a canyon, pressure shapes a channel fakes cannot rush.
